scope: PWA 0.15.1 and management web 0.4.1 on installed wallet API/PWA 0.14.0; API and schema unchanged
management_skip_reason: Native PostgreSQL binaries were not configured in the isolated release worktree. These unchanged database integration tests were not exercised in this run; no application database was used.
browser_coverage: Wallet member filters, private transfer destinations, selected-member empty states and loading/error/retry are retained, including both manager roles at 320/360/390/768/1440 pixels and large negative rial/toman values
Public PWA history at 360 and 1440 pixels; RTL, current version and keyboard close
First installation and ordinary reload have no invented notice; a pending update produces one device-only notice
History opens after a real service-worker-controlled offline reload
Management history remains during loading/error; missing notes and unknown API release are explicit
Exact JSON note identity survives preview picking, English, empty and restored drafts
Existing management authentication, analytics, Excel, feature controls, package installation, backups and operation history remain functional in the isolated demo
installer_coverage: Pinned published wallet API source is accepted; the original 0.13.0 history contract rejects the exact same source
The superseded Home 2 baseline contract and a retained old history journal stop before backups or activation
Source and database failures name the exact check; running-container migration commands are rejected
Unchanged source/schema read-only probes and verified published baseline
Private environment/configuration preservation and modified-source rejection
Protected backups, retained old management assets and repeat execution
Failure between web swaps and between rename steps resumes from the durable journal
HTTP health failure retains both web backups and permits same-package retry
Unknown files and edits stop rather than being discarded
Pinned bootstrap uses atomic extraction and rejects traversal, links and modified retained releases
corrected_failures: The owner's v0.15.0 run stopped before activation because the independent wallet update had changed the installed baseline to 0.14.0. This new tag retains wallet source and pins its exact published manifest.
The first validation attempt caught a duplicate note ID in the newly added 0.15.1 record; the unpublished technical note received its own stable ID.

A shared node_modules junction caused a Workbox resolution error and the first build was terminated at the local timeout. Dependencies were then installed in the isolated worktree, offline from the unchanged lockfile, before repeating verification.
The initial production-browser test used an obsolete navigation label; it now follows the profile/settings control.
The independent management build required its own source alias. Shared list rendering was separated from the PWA dialog so management does not bundle application runtime helpers.
The new offline action inherited pointer-events:none from the informational bar; only the button now accepts pointer events.
The component selector now has an explicit label/for link.
The copy-preview browser check now brings the iframe into the workbench viewport before interacting. No source writes were needed for that test correction.
limits: Linux Docker/systemd and production HTTP failure paths use explicit local doubles; installation is not claimed.
Physical installed-PWA and Android acceptance are not exercised.
The existing application chunk warning above 500 kB remains.
Versions before this feature cannot create the update marker; their first upgrade uses the permanent About history entry.
